Mina / Aditya — finance perspective: Net-90 across the board increases credit risk materially for a mid-market account. If we must stretch terms, I recommend we: 

1) Accept the 30% upfront as proposed.
2) Convert "quarterly invoicing" into milestone invoices tied to delivery/activation milestones (e.g., onboarding complete, production go-live, 90-day usage milestone) — that gives us leverage.
3) For the invoices after the upfront, propose Net-60 instead of Net-90; or if Net-90 is non-negotiable, require an irrevocable PO and a credit review plus a 5% credit surcharge (applied as an annualized finance fee).

If Sales believes LedgerWorks will commit to a minimum 36-month ARR and expansion triggers, we can escalate a Net-90 exception to FP&A and the CRO for approval, but that will require exec sign-off and a one-time finance fee to compensate.

I reviewed the redlines — legal should confirm the change to billing sections and any language that ties payment to successful delivery.

Laura
